title: ContainerTypeValidate: Skip Variant copy when type conversion is not needed
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve? - Supersedes #121081 - Optimizes container type validation (used by many `Array/Dictionary` methods) by skipping an unnecessary Variant copy. ## Additional information - Problem: `ContainerTypeValidate::validate` possibly mutates the input Variant so a copy is always made before calling. The mutation only occurs when the type mismatches but can be coerced. All other cases return the original Variant untouched or error out. - The signature of `ContainerTypeValidate::validate` is changed significantly in this PR. I renamed it to reflect the new behaviour but I am open to other naming ideas. The `bool` return type is moved a ref parameter and the Variant ref param is now split between the `std::optional` return type. If the optional is empty, then the input parameter is to be used as the value. - The implementation uses `std::optional` as I think it is a perfect use of it. If using STL directly is undesired, I can create a wrapper or add a custom implementation. - `Dictionary::getptr` is called as a helper resulting in double validation occurring, this is fixed by adding a version that skips validation. - `std::move` is removed from some places due to it preventing copy elision (I got a compiler warning when using `std::move` on a `value_of` result). - No AI used. I might later for benchmarking. - Draft for now as benchmarks were done on an older branch point. ## Benchmarks
Scenarios | Label | Container type | Variant used type | Current behaviour | Expected result | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A | untyped | `int` | An unnecessary copy is made. | Small gain because copying primitive types are cheap. | | B | untyped | `CustomObject(RefCounted)` | An unnecessary copy is made. | Large gain because copying a ref counted type is expensive. | | C | `int` | `float` | Copy is necessary. | No difference. See the `getptr` changes above. | | D | `CustomObject(RefCounted)` | `CustomObject(RefCounted)` | An unnecessary copy is made. | Large gain because copying a ref counted type is expensive. |
Testing code Put in `tests/core/test_containers.cpp` ```cpp #include "tests/test_macros.h" TEST_FORCE_LINK(test_containers) #include #include #include "core/object/ref_counted.h" class CustomObject : public RefCounted { GDCLASS(CustomObject, RefCounted); }; const int SCENARIOS = 4; namespace DictionaryTests { void setup(Dictionary &d, Variant &v, int scenario) { switch(scenario) { // int, untyped case 0: v = 1; break; // object (refcounted), untyped case 1: v = memnew(CustomObject); break; // int, mismatch case 2: v = 1.1; d.set_typed(Variant::INT, StringName(), Variant(), Variant::INT, StringName(), Variant()); break; // object (refcounted), typed case 3: v = memnew(CustomObject); d.set_typed(Variant::OBJECT, v.operator Object *()->get_class_name(), v.operator Object *()->get_script(), Variant::INT, StringName(), Variant()); break; } } double subscript(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d[v]) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double const_subscript(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { const Variant &w = d[v]; if (w) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double getptr(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.getptr(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double const_getptr(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { const Variant *w = d.getptr(v); if (w) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double get_valid(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); d[v]; const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.get_valid(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double get(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); Variant w(0); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.get(v, w)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double get_or_add(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; Variant w(0); setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.get_or_add(v, w)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double set(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; Variant w(0); setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (!d.set(v, w)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double has(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.has(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double has_all(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); Array a; a.append(v); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.has_all(a)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double find_key(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); // Custom setup if (scenario == 3) { d = Dictionary(); d.set_typed(Variant::INT, StringName(), Variant(), Variant::OBJECT, v.operator Object *()->get_class_name(), v.operator Object *()->get_script()); } const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.find_key(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double erase(int scenario) { Dictionary d; Variant v; setup(d, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (d.erase(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } } namespace ArrayTests { void setup(Array &a, Variant &v, int scenario) { switch(scenario) { // int, untyped case 0: v = 1; break; // object (refcounted), untyped case 1: v = memnew(CustomObject); break; // int, mismatch case 2: v = 1.1; a.set_typed(Variant::INT, StringName(), Variant()); break; // object (refcounted), typed case 3: v = memnew(CustomObject); a.set_typed(Variant::OBJECT, v.operator Object *()->get_class_name(), v.operator Object *()->get_script()); break; } } double push_back(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int A = 100'000; const int B = 1000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < B; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < A; j++) { a.push_back(v); } a.clear(); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / (A * B); printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double append_array(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int A = 1000; const int B = 1000; const int C = 100; Array b; for (int i = 0; i < B; i++) { b.push_back(v); } auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < A; j++) { a.append_array(b); } a.clear(); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / (A * B * C); printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double insert(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int A = 100'000; const int B = 1000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < B; i++) { for (int j = 0; j < A; j++) { a.insert(j, v); } a.clear(); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / (A * B); printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double fill(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int A = 1000; const int B = 1000; const int C = 100; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < C; i++) { a.resize(B); for (int j = 0; j < A; j++) { a.fill(v); } a.clear(); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / (A * B * C); printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double erase(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { a.erase(v); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double find(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); a.push_back(v); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (a.find(v) > 0) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double rfind(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); a.push_back(v); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (a.rfind(v) > 0) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double count(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (a.count(v) > 0) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double has(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if (a.has(v)) { break; } } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } double set(int scenario) { Array a; Variant v; setup(a, v, scenario); const int N = 100'000'000; a.resize(1); auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now(); for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) { a.set(0, v); } double ret = std::chrono::duration(std::chrono::steady_clock::now() - start).count() / N; printf("%.2lf\n", ret); fflush(stdout); return ret; } } static void containers() { // Times to run each test. const int N = 3; LocalVector data[SCENARIOS][N]; #define run_loop(test) printf(#test"\n");\ for (int n = 0; n < N; n++) {\ data[s][n].push_back(test(s));\ }\ for (int s = 0; s < SCENARIOS; s++) { printf("SCENARIO %c\n", 'A' + s); puts("====="); run_loop(DictionaryTests::subscript); run_loop(DictionaryTests::const_subscript); run_loop(DictionaryTests::getptr); run_loop(DictionaryTests::const_getptr); run_loop(DictionaryTests::get_valid); run_loop(DictionaryTests::get); run_loop(DictionaryTests::get_or_add); run_loop(DictionaryTests::set); run_loop(DictionaryTests::has); run_loop(DictionaryTests::has_all); run_loop(DictionaryTests::find_key); run_loop(DictionaryTests::erase); run_loop(ArrayTests::push_back); run_loop(ArrayTests::append_array); run_loop(ArrayTests::insert); run_loop(ArrayTests::erase); run_loop(ArrayTests::find); run_loop(ArrayTests::rfind); run_loop(ArrayTests::count); run_loop(ArrayTests::has); run_loop(ArrayTests::set); printf("\n\n"); } // Print csv-like output for (int s = 0; s < SCENARIOS; s++) { printf("SCENARIO %c\n", 'A' + s); for (unsigned int n = 0; n < N; n++) { for (unsigned int i = 0; i < data[s][n].size(); i++) { printf("%.2lf%c", data[s][n][i], i == data[s][n].size() - 1 ? '\n' : ','); } } } fflush(stdout); } REGISTER_TEST_COMMAND("containers", &containers) ``` Run with `./bin/godot....exe --test containers`
Testing hardware/software CPU: 9800X3D, GPU: RX6800, RAM: 32GB DDR5 6400 CL28 Windows 11. Built with GCC(MinGW) for release templates.
Graphs The program is run 5 times and all 3 runs from each run are aggregated together. The fastest 20th percentile is taken and the ns/op of each "element" operation is shown below. For example, `append_array` is averaged to time per element appended.
